title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,200 arrested after protests
description: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.

title: Watch: Moment historic French town hall spire collapses in flames amid protests
description: An historic town hall in the southern French city of Limoges was set ablaze during national protests.

title: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
description: Officials have not given a cause or death toll, citing the "very active and delicate" situation at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright.

title: NHS faces more challenging winter than normal, health secretary warns
description: Yvette Cooper has announced £140m investment in England's urgent care system, after summer heatwaves piled pressure on the NHS.

title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis

description: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as America battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

title: Dubois destroys Wardley in two rounds to retain WBO title
description: WBO champion Daniel Dubois underlines his status as Britain's leading heavyweight with a devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley.

title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
description: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.

title: There's a crackdown on sports piracy - but is it already out of control?
description: The sports industry's lucrative business model is being undermined by dodgy TV sticks and illegal streaming links, writes Theo Leggett.
